# AI · tools & output

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-blocks.mjs from scripts/blocks-meta.json. Edit that file, not this one. -->

### Tool use
- What: Let an AI model call functions in your code, such as a search, to get facts or take actions.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### JSON mode
- What: A setting that makes an AI model reply in valid JSON.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept

### Structured output
- What: Make the AI reply in a fixed shape that your code checks before using it.
- Applies when: the app's code uses an AI model's answer.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: test
- Done when: AI output used by code is checked against a schema. A malformed answer is retried or refused, never passed on.

### Model selection
- What: Pick the AI model that fits the job's cost and quality, and set that choice in one place.
- Applies when: the app calls an AI model.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: review
- Done when: The model name is pinned in one setting, not scattered through the code or left to a moving default.

### Non-determinism
- What: The same prompt can give different answers each time, so tests check facts, not wording.
- Applies when: the app calls an AI model.
- Stage: day-one-if
- Kind: checkable
- Proof: review
- Done when: Tests of AI features assert facts that must hold, never the exact wording.

### Multimodal input
- What: AI models that take images, audio or files as well as text.
- Applies when: the term comes up.
- Stage: any
- Kind: concept
